answer: Each new agent must lock a bond for a full voyage of epochs before earning: privileges scale only with aged, slashable stake, not headcount. A lantern check — random peer audits — slashes the bond if one operator controls many identities. Faking a crowd therefore costs real capital: 10,000 Sybils need 10,000 bonds locked and at risk under a violet-hot penalty, while one honest agent pays once.
